summary: The trace reveals a critical failure: the agent's self-validation passed but the external verifier rejected the output. Key issues include: (1) Excel sheet name truncated to 31 characters ('10 hr Shift Relocate Grill Guar' instead of 'Guard'), (2) header structure mismatch - missing Date column in verification, (3) the gap between self-validation and external verification. This patch adds Excel sheet name length limits, strengthens header verification guidance, and adds explicit cross-check requirements.
